entries.title: Luke 11:1
segments: One day Jesus was at a certain place praying, and, when he had finished, one of his disciples said to him: "Master, teach us to pray, as John taught his disciples."

entries.title: Luke 11:2
segments: "When you pray," Jesus answered, "say--'Father, May thy named be held holy, thy Kingdom come.

entries.title: Luke 11:3
segments: Give us each day the bread that we shall need;

entries.title: Luke 11:4
segments: And forgive us our sins, for we ourselves forgive every one who wrongs us; and take us not into temptation.'"

entries.title: Luke 11:5
segments: Jesus also said to them: "Suppose that one of you who has a friend were to go to him in the middle of the night and say 'Friend, lend me three loaves,

entries.title: Luke 11:6
segments: For a friend of mine has arrived at my house after a journey, and I have nothing to offer him;'

entries.title: Luke 11:7
segments: And suppose that the other should answer from inside 'Do not trouble me; the door is already fastened, and my children and I are in bed; I cannot get up and give you anything';

entries.title: Luke 11:8
segments: I tell you that, even though he will not get up and give him anything because he is a friend, yet because of his persistence he will rouse himself and give him what he wants.

entries.title: Luke 11:9
segments: And so I say to you--Ask, and your prayer shall be granted: search, and you shall find; knock, and the door shall be opened to you.

entries.title: Luke 11:10
segments: For he that asks receives, he that searches finds, and to him that knocks the door shall be opened.

entries.title: Luke 11:11
segments: What father among you, if his son asks him for a fish, will give him a snake instead,

entries.title: Luke 11:12
segments: Or, if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

entries.title: Luke 11:13
segments: If you, then, naturally wicked though you are, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the Father in Heaven give the Holy Spirit to those that ask him!"

entries.title: Luke 11:14
segments: Once Jesus was driving out a dumb demon, and, when the demon had gone out, the dumb man spoke. The people were amazed at this;

entries.title: Luke 11:15
segments: But some of them said: "He drives out demons by the help of Baal-zebub, the chief of the demons";

entries.title: Luke 11:16
segments: While others, to test him, asked him for some sign from the heavens.

entries.title: Luke 11:17
segments: Jesus himself, however, was aware of what they were thinking, and said to them: "Any kingdom wholly divided against itself becomes a desolation; and a divided house falls.

entries.title: Luke 11:18
segments: So, too, if Satan is wholly divided against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I drive out demons by the help of Baal-zebub.

entries.title: Luke 11:19
segments: But, if it is by Baal-zebub's help that I drive out demons, by whose help is it that your own sons drive them out? Therefore they shall themselves be your judges.

entries.title: Luke 11:20
segments: But, if it is by the hand of God that I drive out demons, then the Kingdom of God must already be upon you.

entries.title: Luke 11:21
segments: When a strong man is keeping guard, fully armed, over his own mansion, his property is in safety;

entries.title: Luke 11:22
segments: But, when one still stronger has attacked and overpowered him, he takes away all the weapons on which the other had relied, and divides his spoil.

entries.title: Luke 11:23
segments: He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not help me to gather is scattering.

entries.title: Luke 11:24
segments: No sooner does a foul spirit leave a man, than it passes through places where there is no water, in search of rest; and finding none, it says 'I will go back to the home which I left';

entries.title: Luke 11:25
segments: But, on coming there, it finds it unoccupied, swept, and put in order.

entries.title: Luke 11:26
segments: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in, and make their home there; and the last state of that man proves to be worse than the first."

entries.title: Luke 11:27
segments: As Jesus was saying this, a woman in the crowd, raising her voice, exclaimed: "Happy was the mother who bore you and nursed you!"

entries.title: Luke 11:28
segments: But Jesus replied: "Rather, happy are those who listen to God's Message and keep it."

entries.title: Luke 11:29
segments: As the crowds increased, Jesus began to speak: "This generation is a wicked generation. It is asking a sign, but no sign shall be given it except the sign of Jonah.

entries.title: Luke 11:30
segments: For, as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so shall the Son of Man be to this generation.

entries.title: Luke 11:31
segments: At the Judgement the Queen of the South will rise up with the men of this generation, and will condemn them, because she came from the very ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon; and here is more than a Solomon!

entries.title: Luke 11:32
segments: At the Judgement the men of Nineveh will stand up with this generation, and will condemn it, because they repented at Jonah's proclamation; and here is more than a Jonah!

entries.title: Luke 11:33
segments: No one sets light to a lamp, and then puts it in the cellar of under the corn-measure, but he puts it on the lamp-stand, so that any one who comes in may see the light.

entries.title: Luke 11:34
segments: The lamp of the body is your eye. When your eye is unclouded, your whole body, also, is lit up; but, as soon as your eye is diseased, your body, also, is darkened.

entries.title: Luke 11:35
segments: Take care, therefore, that the inner Light is not darkness.

entries.title: Luke 11:36
segments: If, then, your whole body is lit up, and no corner of it darkened, the whole will be lit up, just as when a lamp gives you light by its brilliance."

entries.title: Luke 11:37
segments: As Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee asked him to breakfast with him, and Jesus went in and took his place at table.

entries.title: Luke 11:38
segments: The Pharisee noticed, to his astonishment, that Jesus omitted the ceremonial washing before breakfast.

entries.title: Luke 11:39
segments: But the Master said to him: "You Pharisees do, it is true, clean the outside of the cup and of the plate, but inside you yourselves are filled with greed and wickedness.

entries.title: Luke 11:40
segments: Fools! did not the maker of the outside make the inside too?

entries.title: Luke 11:41
segments: Only give away what is in them in charity, and at once you have the whole clean.

entries.title: Luke 11:42
segments: But alas for you Pharisees! You pay tithes on mint, rue, and herbs of all kinds, and pass over justice and love to God. These last you ought to have put into practice without neglecting the first.

entries.title: Luke 11:43
segments: Alas for you Pharisees! You delight to have the front seat in the Synagogues, and to be greeted in the markets with respect.

entries.title: Luke 11:44
segments: Alas for you! You are like unsuspected graves, over which men walk unawares."

entries.title: Luke 11:45
segments: Here one of the Students of the Law interrupted him by saying: "Teacher, when you say this, you are insulting us also."

entries.title: Luke 11:46
segments: But Jesus went on: "Alas for you, too, you Students of the Law! You load men with loads that are too heavy to carry, but do not, yourselves, touch them with one of your fingers.

entries.title: Luke 11:47
segments: Alas for you! You build the monuments of the Prophets whom your ancestors killed.

entries.title: Luke 11:48
segments: You are actually witnesses to your ancestors' acts and show your approval of them, because, while they killed the Prophets, you build tombs for them.

entries.title: Luke 11:49
segments: That is why the Wisdom of God said--"I will send to them Prophets and Apostles,

entries.title: Luke 11:50
segments: Some of whom they will persecute and kill, in order that the 'blood' of all the prophets 'that has been spilt' since the creation of the world may be exacted from this generation--

entries.title: Luke 11:51
segments: From the blood of Abel down to the blood of Zechariah, who was slain between the altar and the House of God." Yes, I tell you, it will be exacted from this generation.

entries.title: Luke 11:52
segments: Alas for you Students of the Law! You have taken away the key of the door of Knowledge. You have not gone in yourselves and you have hindered those who try to go in."

entries.title: Luke 11:53
segments: When Jesus left the house, the Teachers of the Law and the Pharisees began to press him hard and question him closely upon many subjects,

entries.title: Luke 11:54
segments: Laying traps for him, so as to seize upon anything that he might say.
